facts.fact: The Burundi health ministry's Annuaire 2024 states that monthly reports from health facilities and community groups are entered in DHIS2, validated by district and province offices, and compiled by the DSNIS into a national database.
The Annuaire 2024 publishes a national average completeness of 99.6 percent for community (GASC) monthly reports entered in DHIS2 in 2024, with a district-by-district table.
